Team —

Thanks again for interviewing Alex earlier today. Quick ask so we can move this along for hiring manager review and recruiter outreach: please fill the attached scorecard and leave one-line justification bullets for any score that differs by 2+ points from the group median.

Rubric anchors (use the template):
- Technical depth (algorithms/data structures)
- System design (scale, trade-offs)
- Collaboration / communication
- Shipping impact / product sense

Deadline: EOD tomorrow (Friday, Oct 10) so Marissa can assemble a consolidated tally before Monday. If you think there will be > 2-point variance on any category (e.g., someone gives a 3 vs 5), flag it in the doc and we'll do a 20-min sync to resolve.

Attachments: rivera_scorecard_template.xlsx (please upload your completed PDF into the Drive link if easier).

If you already dropped notes in the interview doc, a short confirmation here is fine. I will schedule the sync only if needed based on submissions.

Thanks — Tessa

- System design: 3, 5, 3 => median 3 (variance flagged)

2) Ben & Irene — bring your short justifications to the sync; add inline comments in Drive if you can before 2:30.
3) Tessa — I'll share the final consolidated PDF and next outreach steps to Alex and Hannah within 2 business days of the sync.

If anyone cannot make 15:00 PT, flag here and I'll handle asynchronous resolution (we'll only go async if both Ben and Irene confirm they can accept Marissa's recommended tie-break).

Thanks all — see you at 15:00.
